sourceTitle: France and the Republic A Record of Things Seen and Learned in the French Provinces During the 'Centennial' Year 1889
description: "France and the Republic" by William Henry Hurlbert is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores the political landscape of France during the Third Republic, examining the ramifications of the republican government established in 1870 and its relationship with the French people.
